title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - WestEd - Early Childhood Development Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2026-2027 by and between the District and WestEd, San Francisco, CA, for the latter to provide the CA Teaching Pyramid Framework, designed to guide learning experiences of early childhood professionals during training sessions, facilitate reflective practice through classroom implementation, and ensure sustainability by leadership team development; includes strategies from special education and mental health and incorporates a strong focus on equity and addressing disproportionality; implemented appropriately, children will demonstrate greater social competence, increased emotional literacy, fewer behavior challenges, and be better able to access academic content; compatible with most social-emotional learning curricula, via Early Childhood Development Department, for the period of August 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, in an amount not to exceed $107,600.00.

title: No-Cost Services Agreement 2026-2027- Lincoln - Esperanza Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a No Cost Services Agreement - 2026-2027 by and between the District and Lincoln, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide mental health, behavioral and social emotional support for Tier 3 students and families; support in developing tools and creating learning environments tailored for social emotional success at Esperanza Elementary School, for the period of August 10, 2026 through May 31, 2027, at no cost to the District.
headline: Ratifies a no-cost deal for Lincoln to provide mental health support at Esperanza Elementary

title: Memorandum of Understanding - Alameda Health System - Community Schools and Student Services Department
official_text:
Ratification by the Board of Education of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) by and between the District and Alameda Health System (AHS), to help meet the medical health, mental health education and youth development needs of students, and through partnering with other services providers on campuses to provide a holistic set of wrap-around services that remove barriers to learning and ensure increase access to care, through school-based health centers, the latter will provide the following services: 
1. 	Dental screening and treatment
2. 	Health education for students and families
3. 	Outreach to youth and their families
4. 	Community-wide health promotion events and activities
5. 	Student referrals for services (at Frick Academy Wellness Center and alternate community clinics or community programs)
at no cost to the District, students, or parents unless provided otherwise by this MOU, for the period August 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027, via the Community Schools and Student Services Department.
headline: Ratifies a no-cost agreement with Alameda Health System for school-based health services
summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) has Alameda Health System offer services through school-based health centers: dental screening and treatment, health education for students and families, outreach, community health events, and referrals for care. The services are at no cost to the district, students or parents unless the MOU says otherwise. It covers August 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Grant Award - California Department of Education - WorkAbility I Grant 2026-2027 - District's SELPA - Special Education Department

headline: Accepts a $361,890 state WorkAbility I grant to help students with disabilities prepare for jobs and college

The money pays for instruction and support for employment and education after high school for students served by the district's special education local plan area. The grant covers July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027 and depends on funds being available.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2026-2027 - American Association of Yemeni Students and Professionals - Community Schools and Student Services Department

The program includes academic enrichment, literacy support, mentorship and two field trips, and ends with an Arab Heritage Month showcase. The agreement period is September 1, 2026 through May 31, 2027.
vendor_name: American Association of Yemeni Students and Professionals
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
